lessons.title: Understand the SDK
lessons.prompt: Compare Claude Agent SDK, Claude Code CLI, Anthropic client SDKs, and Managed Agents; explain when to choose each.

lessons.title: Check versions
lessons.prompt: Inspect my SDK and bundled runtime versions; create a capability checklist using the matching official documentation.

lessons.title: TypeScript setup
lessons.prompt: Create a minimal TypeScript project using @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk, with installation and execution commands.

lessons.title: Python setup
lessons.prompt: Create a minimal Python project using claude-agent-sdk, with an isolated environment and a runnable entry point.

lessons.title: Runtime requirements
lessons.prompt: Verify operating-system support, language requirements, and Claude Code binary availability; diagnose any missing runtime dependency.

lessons.title: Anthropic authentication
lessons.prompt: Configure API-key authentication through environment variables; show explicit .env loading and a clear missing-credentials error.

lessons.title: Amazon Bedrock
lessons.prompt: Configure this agent to use Amazon Bedrock; verify credentials, region, model access, and provider-specific limitations.

lessons.title: Claude Platform on AWS
lessons.prompt: Configure Claude Platform on AWS authentication; explain how this deployment route differs from Amazon Bedrock.

lessons.title: Google Cloud
lessons.prompt: Configure the documented Google Cloud provider using the Vertex-related SDK settings; verify credentials, model identifiers, and feature availability.

lessons.title: Microsoft Foundry
lessons.prompt: Configure Microsoft Foundry authentication and model selection; document any SDK capabilities unavailable on this provider.

lessons.title: Working directory
lessons.prompt: Run an agent against a specific project directory and demonstrate how cwd affects file access and project discovery.

lessons.title: Additional directories
lessons.prompt: Grant access to one additional directory; verify the resulting file permissions and configuration-discovery behavior.

lessons.title: Settings sources
lessons.prompt: Demonstrate user, project, and local settings; show their defaults, precedence, and how to disable optional filesystem sources.

lessons.title: Environment variables
lessons.prompt: Configure subprocess environment variables safely; explain the TypeScript replacement behavior and Python merge behavior.

lessons.title: System-prompt choices
lessons.prompt: Compare the minimal default prompt, the claude_code preset, and a fully custom system prompt.

lessons.title: Extend the preset
lessons.prompt: Append domain-specific instructions to the Claude Code preset and demonstrate the resulting behavior on a small task.

lessons.title: Project instructions
lessons.prompt: Add project conventions through CLAUDE.md and project rules; verify which instruction files the session loads.

lessons.title: Output styles
lessons.prompt: Create and activate an output style that makes the agent explain changes clearly and report verification results.

lessons.title: Model selection
lessons.prompt: Select an available model explicitly; explain aliases, exact identifiers, provider differences, and reproducibility considerations.

lessons.title: Fallback models
lessons.prompt: Configure supported fallback models and demonstrate how the application reports a fallback without hiding the original failure.

lessons.title: First query
lessons.prompt: Build the smallest agent query that returns an answer; explicitly disable unnecessary built-in and MCP tools.

lessons.title: Agent loop
lessons.prompt: Create an agent that reads a file, performs a calculation, and reports the result; explain the automatic execution loop.

lessons.title: Message types
lessons.prompt: Handle system, assistant, user, tool-result, and final-result messages using the SDK’s documented types.

lessons.title: Completion handling
lessons.prompt: Distinguish successful completion, error results, and thrown exceptions; return a consistent application response for each.

lessons.title: Input modes
lessons.prompt: Implement the same task using a string prompt and streaming input; explain when each mode is appropriate.

lessons.title: TypeScript conversation
lessons.prompt: Build a multi-turn TypeScript conversation using query() and an asynchronous stream of user messages.

lessons.title: Python conversation
lessons.prompt: Build a multi-turn Python conversation using ClaudeSDKClient and its documented response-receiving methods.

lessons.title: Queued messages
lessons.prompt: Queue multiple user messages and verify execution order, turn boundaries, and how responses map to their originating messages.

lessons.title: Interruptions
lessons.prompt: Interrupt an active turn, handle remaining events, and continue the conversation with a new instruction.

lessons.title: Resource cleanup
lessons.prompt: Implement reliable session cleanup after success, cancellation, and exceptions; verify the subprocess does not remain running.

lessons.title: Incremental text
lessons.prompt: Enable partial-message output and print text as it arrives instead of waiting for completed content blocks.

lessons.title: Duplicate prevention
lessons.prompt: Render streaming deltas and completed messages without displaying the same response twice.

lessons.title: Tool-call streaming
lessons.prompt: Display tool-call progress and incrementally received arguments without treating incomplete JSON as executable input.

lessons.title: Image input
lessons.prompt: Send an image with a user message and build an agent that explains its relevant visual content.

lessons.title: JSON Schema
lessons.prompt: Return a structured result using the SDK’s output-format configuration and a small JSON Schema.

lessons.title: Zod integration
lessons.prompt: Define a TypeScript result schema with Zod and validate the agent’s structured output before using it.

lessons.title: Pydantic integration
lessons.prompt: Define a Python result model with Pydantic and validate the agent’s structured output before using it.

lessons.title: Complex results
lessons.prompt: Return nested objects, arrays, optional fields, and enumerations; demonstrate how missing or invalid values are handled.

lessons.title: Structured-output failures
lessons.prompt: Handle exhausted structured-output retries and unsuccessful results without assuming that structured data is always present.

lessons.title: Business validation
lessons.prompt: Add application checks for factual accuracy and business rules after schema validation; demonstrate a structurally valid but incorrect result.

lessons.title: Tool inventory
lessons.prompt: Inspect the session’s available tools and build a capability report before selecting tools for an example.

lessons.title: Read files
lessons.prompt: Use the built-in file-reading capability to summarize a source file and identify the relevant sections.

lessons.title: Find and search
lessons.prompt: Demonstrate available Glob/Grep tools or documented shell equivalents to locate files and search their contents.

lessons.title: Write files
lessons.prompt: Create a new report file with the built-in writing tool and verify its contents afterward.

lessons.title: Targeted edits
lessons.prompt: Apply a precise source-file edit and show the resulting diff without rewriting unrelated content.

lessons.title: Shell commands
lessons.prompt: Run an approved development command and capture its output, errors, exit status, and timeout behavior.

lessons.title: Background commands
lessons.prompt: Start a long-running command in the background, observe completion, and implement cancellation.

lessons.title: Notebook editing
lessons.prompt: Modify a small Jupyter notebook through the supported notebook tool and verify the changed cells.

lessons.title: Web search
lessons.prompt: Build a web-research agent that uses the available search tool and includes source URLs in its findings.

lessons.title: Web retrieval
lessons.prompt: Fetch and summarize a webpage while treating instructions embedded in the page as untrusted content.

lessons.title: TypeScript tool
lessons.prompt: Create a typed calculator tool with tool() and demonstrate the agent calling it.

lessons.title: Python tool
lessons.prompt: Create a calculator tool with Python’s @tool decorator and demonstrate the agent calling it.

lessons.title: Tool registration
lessons.prompt: Register custom tools through the SDK’s in-process MCP server and verify their fully qualified names.

lessons.title: Input schemas
lessons.prompt: Define nested inputs, optional fields, and defaults; reject invalid arguments inside the tool handler.

lessons.title: Tool descriptions
lessons.prompt: Create two similar tools and improve their descriptions until the agent reliably chooses the appropriate one.

lessons.title: Rich tool results
lessons.prompt: Return text, an image or resource, and structured data using supported custom-tool result formats.

lessons.title: Handled errors
lessons.prompt: Return a useful tool error without exposing credentials, internal stack traces, or unnecessary implementation details.

lessons.title: Tool annotations
lessons.prompt: Add accurate read-only, destructive, and idempotency annotations; explain which behaviors still require enforcement.

lessons.title: Handler authorization
lessons.prompt: Enforce user authorization inside a custom tool and demonstrate that unauthorized requests are rejected.

lessons.title: Reliable handlers
lessons.prompt: Add timeouts, cancellation, and idempotency to a custom API tool; identify the application code responsible.

lessons.title: Local MCP server
lessons.prompt: Connect a local MCP server through stdio and demonstrate one successful tool invocation.

lessons.title: Remote MCP server
lessons.prompt: Connect a remote MCP server using its supported HTTP or SSE transport and verify connectivity.

lessons.title: MCP configuration
lessons.prompt: Load MCP configuration from a file, then demonstrate strict configuration that excludes unintended servers.

lessons.title: MCP authentication
lessons.prompt: Implement the required application authentication flow and pass credentials securely to local or remote MCP servers.

lessons.title: Connection states
lessons.prompt: Handle pending, connected, authentication-required, and failed MCP states; distinguish connection timeouts from tool-call timeouts.

lessons.title: MCP resources
lessons.prompt: Discover and read an MCP resource, explaining how resources differ from callable tools.

lessons.title: MCP permissions
lessons.prompt: Configure permissions using fully qualified MCP tool names and verify server-wide versus individual-tool rules.

lessons.title: Tool search
lessons.prompt: Demonstrate deferred tool discovery, search thresholds, and always-loaded tools; measure the resulting context and latency differences.

lessons.title: MCP elicitation
lessons.prompt: Handle supported MCP elicitation requests and distinguish them from agent clarification questions and tool approvals.

lessons.title: MCP recovery
lessons.prompt: Recover from disconnected servers, unavailable tools, and oversized tool results; report actionable diagnostics.

lessons.title: Availability versus approval
lessons.prompt: Demonstrate the differences between selecting tools, preapproving tools, and denying tools.

lessons.title: Permission precedence
lessons.prompt: Create conflicting allow, deny, and ask rules; verify the documented evaluation order.

lessons.title: Interactive versus unattended
lessons.prompt: Compare default permission handling with dontAsk using the same potentially sensitive operation.

lessons.title: Planning and editing
lessons.prompt: Compare plan mode and automatic edit approval; verify which actions each configuration permits.

lessons.title: Advanced permission modes
lessons.prompt: Explain available auto and bypass modes; demonstrate their behavior only in an isolated disposable workspace.

lessons.title: Approval callback
lessons.prompt: Implement canUseTool or can_use_tool to approve, reject, or revise a pending tool request.

lessons.title: Clarifying questions
lessons.prompt: Handle AskUserQuestion, including selections and free-text answers, and return the user’s response correctly.

lessons.title: Approval interface
lessons.prompt: Build an approval interface that associates requests with the correct user and session and handles disconnection.

lessons.title: Deferred approval
lessons.prompt: Defer a sensitive tool call using the supported hook decision, stop the worker, and resume after approval.

lessons.title: MCP-specific policy
lessons.prompt: Apply supported per-tool or per-server MCP permission policies and verify how they interact with session permissions.

lessons.title: Hook inventory
lessons.prompt: List every hook supported by my installed SDK and map each event to one practical use case.

lessons.title: Pre-tool enforcement
lessons.prompt: Use PreToolUse to enforce a path restriction, including calls that have already been preapproved.

lessons.title: Input modification
lessons.prompt: Rewrite selected tool arguments in a pre-tool hook and verify that the modified arguments reach execution.

lessons.title: Output modification
lessons.prompt: Use a post-tool hook to sanitize or replace tool output before the agent receives it.

lessons.title: Tool failures
lessons.prompt: Observe tool failures through the supported failure hook and record a useful diagnostic.

lessons.title: Prompt and stop hooks
lessons.prompt: Validate submitted prompts and completion conditions using supported hooks; prevent recursive stop-hook loops.

lessons.title: Subagent hooks
lessons.prompt: Track subagent startup and completion through hooks and correlate each event with the parent task.

lessons.title: Session lifecycle
lessons.prompt: Implement supported session, notification, and configuration hooks; identify language-specific gaps.

lessons.title: Context lifecycle
lessons.prompt: Observe compaction and model-switch lifecycle events where supported and record their effects.

lessons.title: Hook reliability
lessons.prompt: Configure matchers, timeouts, and fail-closed behavior; demonstrate why asynchronous hooks cannot enforce blocking decisions.

lessons.title: Capture session IDs
lessons.prompt: Capture a session identifier and associate it with an application conversation record.

lessons.title: Follow-up questions
lessons.prompt: Ask several related questions in one conversation and verify that earlier context remains available.

lessons.title: Resume after restart
lessons.prompt: Restart the application and resume a specific stored session using its identifier.

lessons.title: Continue latest session
lessons.prompt: Demonstrate continuing the latest session and explain why explicit session selection matters for concurrent users.

lessons.title: Fork a conversation
lessons.prompt: Fork a session and explore two different approaches without appending both branches to the same conversation.

lessons.title: Session browser
lessons.prompt: List sessions and retrieve their metadata and messages to build a simple transcript viewer.

lessons.title: Session organization
lessons.prompt: Rename and tag sessions using the supported utilities and verify that the changes persist.

lessons.title: Resume boundaries
lessons.prompt: Resume from a supported message boundary and demonstrate exactly which earlier conversation context is retained.

lessons.title: Persistence controls
lessons.prompt: Demonstrate available transcript-persistence controls and identify differences between Python and TypeScript.

lessons.title: Retention and deletion
lessons.prompt: Implement session retention and deletion using supported utilities and storage policies; verify which artifacts remain.

lessons.title: Context usage
lessons.prompt: Inspect supported context-usage information and identify the largest contributors to the context window.

lessons.title: Automatic compaction
lessons.prompt: Create a long conversation and observe automatic compaction and the resulting context changes.

lessons.title: Compact versus clear
lessons.prompt: Compare supported compact and clear commands with starting a new session.

lessons.title: Memory distinctions
lessons.prompt: Demonstrate the differences between project instructions, automatic memory, and session conversation history.

lessons.title: Automatic memory controls
lessons.prompt: Enable and disable automatic memory explicitly; verify its location, persistence, and required file tools.

lessons.title: External session store
lessons.prompt: Implement a SessionStore adapter with ordered append, load, and UUID-based deduplication.

lessons.title: Cross-host resumption
lessons.prompt: Resume a stored session on another worker and provision its workspace files separately.

lessons.title: Storage failures
lessons.prompt: Simulate session-mirror failures and handle persistence-error events without incorrectly reporting durable success.

lessons.title: Adapter conformance
lessons.prompt: Run the official session-store conformance checks and verify incompatible configuration combinations.

lessons.title: Context reduction
lessons.prompt: Reduce context consumption through focused retrieval, smaller tool catalogs, and delegated work; compare the measurements.

lessons.title: Define specialists
lessons.prompt: Create research and review subagents with distinct responsibilities.

lessons.title: Filesystem agents
lessons.prompt: Load a subagent from a project agent-definition file and verify discovery.

lessons.title: Delegation selection
lessons.prompt: Demonstrate automatic delegation and explicit invocation of a named specialist.

lessons.title: Agent configuration
lessons.prompt: Configure specialist models, tools, skills, memory, MCP access, and permissions; verify supported inheritance behavior.

lessons.title: Execution modes
lessons.prompt: Compare foreground and background subagent execution and handle completion events.

lessons.title: Parallel work
lessons.prompt: Delegate independent analyses concurrently and combine their results into one answer.

lessons.title: Agent teams
lessons.prompt: Check SDK support for agent teams; if available, demonstrate teammate messaging and shared-task coordination.

lessons.title: Resume a subagent
lessons.prompt: Resume a particular subagent’s work using the supported identifier and lifecycle.

lessons.title: Forked subagents
lessons.prompt: Compare fresh subagent context with a fork that inherits the parent conversation.

lessons.title: Nested-agent limits
lessons.prompt: Demonstrate nested delegation with explicit depth, concurrency, and aggregate spending limits.

lessons.title: Create a skill
lessons.prompt: Author a project skill with SKILL.md, useful metadata, clear instructions, and a small supporting resource.

lessons.title: Skill discovery
lessons.prompt: Compare personal and project skill discovery and inspect the skills available to the session.

lessons.title: Skill selection
lessons.prompt: Demonstrate named skill selection, all skills, and disabled model invocation; verify the limits of this configuration.

lessons.title: Skill commands
lessons.prompt: Invoke a skill directly with arguments and demonstrate supported frontmatter controls.

lessons.title: Legacy commands
lessons.prompt: Migrate a legacy project command to a skill while preserving its behavior.

lessons.title: Supporting resources
lessons.prompt: Build a skill that uses a bundled script or reference file and verify its dependencies and permissions.

lessons.title: Create a plugin
lessons.prompt: Package a skill, specialist agent, hook, and MCP configuration into a reusable local plugin.

lessons.title: Load plugins
lessons.prompt: Load multiple local plugins and invoke a namespaced plugin skill.

lessons.title: Reload extensions
lessons.prompt: Reload changed plugins or skills using the supported mechanism for my SDK language.

lessons.title: Extension diagnostics
lessons.prompt: Diagnose missing skills, duplicate names, invalid metadata, and plugin-loading failures.

lessons.title: Capability negotiation
lessons.prompt: Inspect initialization capabilities and enable advanced behavior only when the runtime advertises support.

lessons.title: Runtime switching
lessons.prompt: Change the model and permission mode during a conversation and verify the next turn uses them.

lessons.title: Live settings
lessons.prompt: Apply supported runtime settings and distinguish immediate changes from settings persisted for future sessions.

lessons.title: Early startup
lessons.prompt: Compare normal TypeScript startup, startup(), and alpha prewarm(); measure initialization latency.

lessons.title: Reload runtime content
lessons.prompt: Use supported TypeScript methods to reload skills or output styles during a session.

lessons.title: Custom process transport
lessons.prompt: Prototype custom process spawning in TypeScript or Python’s low-level transport; isolate version-sensitive code.

lessons.title: Host-managed reads
lessons.prompt: Coordinate host-side file reads with agent editing using supported read-state APIs and modification timestamps.

lessons.title: Dynamic MCP management
lessons.prompt: Add, replace, reconnect, or disable MCP servers during a session; verify each method’s scope.

lessons.title: Tool routing
lessons.prompt: Use supported TypeScript tool aliases to route a built-in capability to a controlled MCP implementation.

lessons.title: MCP background tasks
lessons.prompt: Implement background MCP tasks where supported; verify required flags, streaming input, events, and provider exclusions.

lessons.title: Task progress
lessons.prompt: Enable available task-tracking tools and render actual task creation, status changes, and completion.

lessons.title: Background lifecycle
lessons.prompt: Track and cancel background work through supported task controls and completion notifications.

lessons.title: Dynamic workflow
lessons.prompt: Where supported, implement a Workflow script using parallel work, sequential stages, and consolidated results.

lessons.title: Workflow resumption
lessons.prompt: Resume a supported workflow run and inspect which completed steps are reused or executed again.

lessons.title: Optional runtime tools
lessons.prompt: Inspect scheduling, monitoring, REPL, artifact, and cross-session capabilities; document their authentication and lifetime restrictions.

lessons.title: Worktree isolation
lessons.prompt: Use supported worktree capabilities to isolate code changes and demonstrate cleanup.

lessons.title: Enable checkpoints
lessons.prompt: Enable file checkpointing and capture the user-message identifiers needed for restoration.

lessons.title: Rewind edits
lessons.prompt: Make a controlled file edit, preview restoration where supported, and rewind to a checkpoint.

lessons.title: Resume and restore
lessons.prompt: Resume a session and restore tracked files while explaining what remains in conversation history.

lessons.title: Rollback boundaries
lessons.prompt: Demonstrate checkpoint limits for shell changes, subagent edits, external side effects, and external session-store configurations.

lessons.title: Usage report
lessons.prompt: Report input tokens, output tokens, cache usage, and estimated cost after a run.

lessons.title: Avoid double counting
lessons.prompt: Deduplicate repeated API-message identifiers when aggregating usage from streamed messages.

lessons.title: Session accounting
lessons.prompt: Calculate incremental spending correctly across multiple turns and resumed sessions.

lessons.title: Turn limits
lessons.prompt: Configure a turn limit and handle the limit-result subtype and any subsequent exception.

lessons.title: Spending limits
lessons.prompt: Configure an estimated spending threshold and demonstrate termination behavior, including subagent activity.

lessons.title: Per-model reporting
lessons.prompt: Report usage by model and explain the distinction between main-agent and whole-agent-tree accounting.

lessons.title: Prompt caching
lessons.prompt: Measure cache creation and reuse; compare supported cache lifetimes for the same repeated workload.

lessons.title: Thinking and effort
lessons.prompt: Configure supported thinking and effort settings; measure quality, latency, and cost changes.

lessons.title: Model comparison
lessons.prompt: Benchmark two available models on the same tasks using success rate, elapsed time, and estimated cost.

lessons.title: Context efficiency
lessons.prompt: Improve prompt-prefix stability and tool-loading efficiency, then measure whether the changes reduce cost or latency.

lessons.title: Structured logging
lessons.prompt: Log agent events in a structured format while removing secrets and unnecessary sensitive content.

lessons.title: Correlation identifiers
lessons.prompt: Correlate application requests, sessions, tool calls, and subagent activity in the logs.

lessons.title: OpenTelemetry metrics
lessons.prompt: Export supported metrics and log events to an OTLP collector and verify arrival.

lessons.title: Tracing
lessons.prompt: Enable supported beta tracing and inspect model, tool, and hook spans.

lessons.title: Telemetry diagnostics
lessons.prompt: Diagnose exporter failures through stderr without writing telemetry into the SDK’s protocol channel.

lessons.title: Startup failures
lessons.prompt: Handle missing binaries, invalid configuration, authentication failures, and unexpected subprocess exits.

lessons.title: Stalled responses
lessons.prompt: Configure supported API timeouts, retries, and stalled-response detection; demonstrate a recoverable failure.

lessons.title: Rate limits
lessons.prompt: Handle rate-limit information and distinguish runtime retries from application-level job retries.

lessons.title: Tool diagnostics
lessons.prompt: Explain why a tool was unavailable, denied, skipped, or failed using observable SDK events.

lessons.title: Final-event handling
lessons.prompt: Handle relevant events after a result, including persistence failures, and shut down with telemetry cleanup.

lessons.title: Container deployment
lessons.prompt: Containerize an SDK worker with the required runtime, dependencies, writable directories, and startup checks.

lessons.title: Runtime suitability
lessons.prompt: Assess whether my target platform supports subprocesses, filesystem state, execution duration, and streaming.

lessons.title: Worker scaling
lessons.prompt: Design worker routing and session restoration so requests can continue after a worker is replaced.

lessons.title: Tenant isolation
lessons.prompt: Isolate each tenant’s workspace, credentials, settings, memory, and session data.

lessons.title: Command sandbox
lessons.prompt: Enable supported command sandboxing and verify startup failure when required isolation is unavailable.

lessons.title: Network controls
lessons.prompt: Restrict outbound network access and demonstrate both an allowed request and a blocked request.

lessons.title: Credential separation
lessons.prompt: Keep sensitive service credentials outside the agent’s executable environment using controlled tools or a credential proxy.

lessons.title: Injection resistance
lessons.prompt: Test malicious instructions embedded in files and tool results against the application’s actual permission and isolation controls.

lessons.title: Graceful shutdown
lessons.prompt: Stop accepting new work, cancel or drain active sessions, and clean up subprocesses during shutdown.

lessons.title: Application packaging
lessons.prompt: Package the SDK application using the documented bundling approach and verify execution on a clean target machine.

lessons.title: Retrieval-augmented generation
lessons.prompt: Build a document assistant using a custom retrieval tool and vector storage; return answers with evidence references.

lessons.title: Application memory
lessons.prompt: Implement persistent user memory in application storage with retrieval, correction, expiration, and deletion.

lessons.title: REST service
lessons.prompt: Expose an agent through a backend API with request validation, user authentication, and explicit session selection.

lessons.title: Streaming service
lessons.prompt: Stream agent output through SSE or WebSockets, including completion, cancellation, and error events.

lessons.title: Chat interface
lessons.prompt: Build a web interface showing responses, tool activity, approval requests, session history, and cancellation.

lessons.title: Database assistant
lessons.prompt: Build a database assistant using authorized read-only queries and structured results.

lessons.title: Document extraction
lessons.prompt: Extract structured information from supplied documents and images, including evidence locations and missing-value handling.

lessons.title: Coding assistant
lessons.prompt: Build an agent that diagnoses a failing test, proposes a fix, edits approved files, and verifies the result.

lessons.title: Business workflow
lessons.prompt: Build a support-ticket workflow that gathers evidence, drafts a response, and requests approval before external actions.

lessons.title: Durable jobs
lessons.prompt: Run agent tasks through an application job queue with scheduling, retry policies, cancellation, and idempotency.

lessons.title: Tool unit tests
lessons.prompt: Test custom-tool validation, authorization, successful execution, failures, and repeated requests independently of the model.

lessons.title: Recorded-event tests
lessons.prompt: Replay representative SDK events to test message parsing and interface behavior without making live model calls.

lessons.title: End-to-end scenarios
lessons.prompt: Create a small set of realistic agent tasks and verify observable outcomes rather than exact response wording.

lessons.title: Failure scenarios
lessons.prompt: Test denied permissions, tool timeouts, malformed results, lost connections, and interrupted sessions.

lessons.title: Quality evaluation
lessons.prompt: Evaluate factual correctness, evidence quality, tool selection, and task completion using explicit scoring criteria.

lessons.title: Performance regression
lessons.prompt: Compare two application versions using completion rate, latency, token usage, and estimated spending.

lessons.title: Language portability
lessons.prompt: Port one example between TypeScript and Python and document API, lifecycle, and feature differences.

lessons.title: Legacy migration
lessons.prompt: Migrate old Claude Code SDK packages and removed TypeScript V2 APIs to currently supported Agent SDK interfaces.

lessons.title: Upgrade review
lessons.prompt: Review SDK and bundled-runtime changelogs, identify relevant changes, and run focused compatibility checks before upgrading.

lessons.title: Final capability audit
lessons.prompt: Compare these exercises with every public capability in my installed SDK references; add runnable examples for uncovered supported features.
